subject: Mobile Development
title: The Small Developer Exception
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Small Developer Exception.

hook.text: In 2020, Apple quietly lowered its cut to 15% — but only for small developers.

buildup.text: The App Store Small Business Program halves the fee for developers earning under $1M a year.

discovery.text: Google matched with a similar 15% tier for the first $1M in annual revenue.

twist.text: Most revenue comes from big developers who still pay 30%. The cut barely affects Apple's income.

climax.text: The reduced rate was a PR move during antitrust scrutiny more than a financial concession.

punchline.text: Fifteen percent for the small; thirty for the rest.

quiz.question: Who qualifies for Apple's reduced 15% commission?
